description: OO method-override discovery across many handler classes. The agent must enumerate AFF object handlers, inspect each one's `is_deserializable` implementation, and identify any handler that diverges from the base by returning `abap_false`. Multi-needle success — any of the six valid handlers passes.
prompt: Find an AFF object handler class that overrides is_deserializable to return abap_false. Reply with only the class name.
notes: Originally framed as a plural-answer question; reframed as single-target with multi-needle so any correct handler passes the same multi-hop discovery without format-trapping the agent.
